title: Introduce unified IR and soft-validate passes for routing policies
creator: Maya Chen
description: Refactor the routing policy ingestion pipeline to emit a compact, unambiguous intermediate representation (IR) and run light-weight soft-validate passes. Goal: make region selection, tier routing, and fallback-model logic deterministic, debuggable in-console, and canary-safe. Soft-validate mode preserves backward compatibility by surfacing warnings instead of hard rejecting old/ambiguous rules, enabling staged migration for customers.
acceptance_criteria: New IR schema documented and checked into confluence
Policy ingestion emits IR in staging and can be toggled via feature-flag
Soft-validate pass reports warnings with actionable codes; no hard failures for existing rules by default
Console surfaces top-3 validation warnings with links to remediation docs
End-to-end canary exercised: 10% of traffic routed through new pipeline with automatic rollback on SLO regressions
Benchmarks show <=5% p50 latency regression for hosted flow at baseline load; any regression >5% blocks rollout
comments: 2025-02-18 Maya C: Kickoff spike completed. Evaluated two IR shapes: a verbose typed AST and a compact tuple-based IR. Opted for compact IR to reduce serialization size and improve validator locality.

2025-02-20 Diego A: Prototype IR emitter implemented (branch: feature/ir-emitter). Added translation layer from existing policy DSL to IR. Small perf cost measured during emit; will profile in next run.

2025-02-22 PM (Liam S): PM review - prefer default 'soft-validate' enabled for hosted customers but disabled for Dedicated until enterprise opt-in. Updated acceptance criteria to reflect canary gating.
2025-02-24 Design (Priya K): Console UX notes added. Need explicit link from rule inspector to validation docs and a one-click 'open remediation PR' that scaffolds changes for common warnings.
2025-02-25 Eng (Diego A): Added warning taxonomy: SYNTAX_WARN, AMBIGUOUS_REGION, TIER_CONFLICT, FALLBACK_MISMATCH. Each warning includes remediation hint and optional quick-fix where safe.
2025-02-27 Perf run: staging workload (1000 rps) shows +3.2% p50 when IR emitter enabled for synchronous path. Action: move canonicalization to background worker and cache results per-policy digest.
2025-02-28 Security (Arjun M): Reviewed threat model. No new secrets exposure. Recommend adding audit log entries for soft-validate outcomes to meet compliance needs for Private customers.
2025-03-01 PR open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing-engine/pull/634 (IR emitter + soft-validate harness). Seeking 2x eng reviewers and PM sign-off for canary.

2025-03-02 Diego A: Canaries configured in runtime: 10% traffic to feature-flagged path, automatic rollback if error-rate > 0.5% or p99 latency increases >10%. Running canary now; monitoring dashboard link: https://dashboard.redwood.ai/d/routing/canary-951234
